playback_tips: Hits and whooshes have an _b variant: pick one at random each time so repeated hits don't sound like a loop.
Add a random pitch change of about plus or minus 5 percent (Phaser: sound.play(key, { rate: 0.95 + Math.random()*0.1 })).
Fire the sound on the exact attack or hit frame; a late sound feels like lag.
Keep hits loud and stings quieter: hits at volume 1.0, specials 0.8, UI stingers 0.6.
Never stack the same clip on itself; if a boss special fires rings three times, play martino_special once.
